What laws? Life grows. Life makes more life. Young ones like parents. Things change - land change, water change, animal use body part or not use it, body part change too. Many babies born, more than land can feed. This bring fight for food and space. Fight bring Natural Pick. Natural Pick make animals go different ways, make weak kinds die out.

So: war in nature. Hunger. Death. From this come big thing - big animals, smart animals, come from this fight. This come straight from war and death.

Big thing to see here. Life-power breathed into few small things, maybe one small thing, long ago. Earth spin and spin, follow same pull-down law, never stop. From one small start, many forms come. Forms beautiful. Forms wonderful. Forms still coming now.
